notes: Fixed: the two truck bed side panels (b38, b39) now rest on the red sloped side bricks (b20, b21), which have studs. They no longer rest on the 1x4 tiles (b35, b36), which have none.
Parts-list counts were matched by type: 127 pieces, including the sticker sheet.

Three sub-models: the pickup truck (b1-b64), the trailer (b65-b112) and the saw station (b113-b127). The booklet builds them separately. The saw station is set on the trailer in the last trailer step, so its base (b113) rests on the trailer pieces below it.
The minifig's own parts (head, torso, legs, helmet) are not in the parts list, so they are not recorded.
Pieces hung under a plate in the final model (wheel holders, tow hook) are shown resting on that plate, because the model is built flipped.

Several placements are best guesses from small, low-detail pictures: the exact support pieces for plates, panels, clips and grilles, and which of the identical 1x2 and 1x4 plates goes where. Colours and counts follow the parts list exactly.
The two 44568 hinge plates carry the red 44569 tailgates. Each is joined by hinge fingers, not by resting on the plate.
The sticker sheet is applied to the roof, door and gauge areas. Only the roof join is listed.
The hose nozzle is only joined to the cord. Its resting place on the trailer gate is not recorded.
